The company's compounded sales growth over 5 years at 50% [E15] and over 10 years at 35% [E14] are impressive, outpacing the sector median of 16.5% [E63]. This further supports the notion that Brijlaxmi Leasing & Finance Ltd is undervalued. While the company's dividend yield is currently zero [E4] and its stock has only reached 18% of its 52-week high [E5], these factors do not outweigh the strong evidence in favor of an underappreciated valuation. The sector median sales growth at 16.5% [E63] suggests that Brijlaxmi Leasing & Finance Ltd is performing above average, which should be reflected in its stock price. In conclusion, based on the provided evidence, Brijlaxmi Leasing & Finance Ltd appears to be undervalued and underappreciated by the market.
